#[inductive(combiner_recv)]
fn combiner_recv_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self) {

    assert(forall |i| post.request_stored(i) ==> pre.request_stored(i));
    assert(forall |i| post.response_stored(i) ==> pre.response_stored(i));
